answer: The Design mockup approved in peer review backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Like a horizon in a workshop, one odd piece hides easily, so the check runs on every submission rather than a sample. A tundra alone is noise; a terrace of accepted work is a pattern the network can trust.
